title: Commentaries of Proclus on the Timaeus, Vol. 2
author: Proclus (Taylor trans)
description: The second volume of Proclus's commentary on Plato's Timaeus in Thomas Taylor's translation. It continues the philosophical interpretation of the cosmos and the relationships between its intelligible model, soul and visible order.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/proclusontimaeus02procuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
